about: Daily YouTube Shorts queue for Final Clearance. A scheduled task uploads each clip through YouTube Studio on the day before or the morning of its publish time, schedules it, and records the video ID here. Times are US Eastern. Weekdays publish at 18:00, weekends at 12:00. TikTok (@final.clearance0) gets the same clip at the same time; each item tracks it under 'tiktok'.

items.title: This jet was cleared to land. There's still a plane on the runway. Would you have caught it? ✈️
items.description:
A jet on final, cleared to land, and a plane still lined up on the runway. You're the tower: send it around. Real gameplay from Final Clearance, an air traffic control game for iPhone and iPad.

Search "Final Clearance" on the App Store.

#atc #airtrafficcontrol #aviation #avgeek #iosgames #indiegame

items.title: A student pilot's instructor collapses mid-flight. You talk them home. 🚑
items.description:
A student pilot. The instructor just collapsed. You're the only one who can talk them home: one heading at a time, calm and clear of traffic. Mission 2, Medical Emergency, new in Final Clearance 1.1.

items.title: 9 in 100 make the cut. 2 make it all the way. Could you? ✈️
items.description:
Not a game of hundreds of easy levels. Ten ranks, each harder than the last, and the real odds of becoming an air traffic controller: of every 100 people who apply to the FAA, about 9 get an offer and about 2 make it all the way (U.S. GAO report GAO-26-107320, 2026). Real gameplay from Final Clearance, an air traffic control game for iPhone and iPad.

Search "Final Clearance" on the App Store.

#atc #airtrafficcontrol #aviation #avgeek #iosgames

items.title: I stopped answering the radio for two minutes. Think you'd last longer? 📻
items.description:
Rank 4, Harbor City. Arrivals lining up on the arcs, and then nobody answers the radio. Calls pile up. Safety drops. Comment your grade if you think you'd last longer. Real gameplay from Final Clearance, an air traffic control game for iPhone and iPad.

items.title: Day one vs. Chief Controller: from one runway to a four-runway hub ✈️
items.description:
Rank 1 is a rural strip with one runway and a few Cessnas. Rank 10 is a four-runway hub where every taxi route is yours. Every rank teaches a real ATC skill. Real gameplay from Final Clearance, an air traffic control game for iPhone and iPad.

items.title: This jet has to wait behind an A380. Would you have held it back? ✈️
items.description:
An A380 on final and an Airbus right behind it. Three miles is normally enough, but not behind an A380: its wake can roll a smaller jet. So this one waits for seven. Real gameplay from Final Clearance, an air traffic control game for iPhone and iPad.

Search "Final Clearance" on the App Store.

#a380 #waketurbulence #atc #aviation #avgeek #iosgames

items.title: Two jets, one taxiway, nose to nose. Would you have spotted the way out? ✈️
items.description:
Two jets meet nose to nose on the only taxiway, and jets can't back up. Pull one into an empty gate and let the other one squeeze past. Real gameplay from Final Clearance, an air traffic control game for iPhone and iPad.

items.title: The wind swung 180°. Real towers turn the whole airport around 🌬️
items.description:
The forecast says the wind is about to swing around. Now the runway has a tailwind, so the tower turns the whole airport around: every arrival and departure flips direction. Real gameplay from Final Clearance, an air traffic control game for iPhone and iPad.

items.title: Three planes, one runway. Who goes first? ✈️
items.description:
A slow Cessna is first in line, with a 737 at more than twice its speed stuck behind it. Put the fast one first and everyone lands sooner. Get the order wrong and the whole line ends up holding. Real gameplay from Final Clearance, an air traffic control game for iPhone and iPad.
